title: 2006 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: John is walking east at a speed of \(3\) miles per hour, while Bob is also walking east, but at a speed of \(5\) miles per hour. If Bob is now \(1\) mile west of John, how many minutes will it take for Bob to catch up to John?

solutions.text:
Bob closes the gap at a relative speed of \(5 - 3 = 2\) miles per hour. To cover the \(1\)-mile gap takes \[\frac{1}{2}\] hour, or \(30\) minutes.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Bob gains ground at the difference of the two speeds
He must close a \(1\)-mile gap at \(5 - 3\) miles per hour
